title: 'Wow. Takes something true and obvious and gives it a name and a face'
summary: Randall — San Francisco reader whose Goodreads friend graph is anchored by Eric Migicovsky (Pebble founder, Beeper CEO) and Gustaf Alstromer (YC partner) — gives Incorruptible 5 stars in a one-sitting read. The pull quote names the corruption-as-default framing in three lines.
blockquote:
Wow. Takes something true and obvious and gives it a name and a face

Corruption is the default. Every organization is pushing against corruption, and the ones that are most successful actually build from the outset to prevent it.

This book was insanely great. I read it in one sitting, and it really changed my perspective on a lot of ideas.
